name: Dole Whip Frozen Pineapple Soft Serve
whyItWorks: A world-famous dry-mix soft serve formulated with pure fruit solids, coconut oil, and sugar. 100% vegan, dairy-free, fat-free, gluten-free, and seedless. Refreshing and silky smooth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy in small dishes. If sensitive to tropical fruit acid, eat slowly or choose vanilla/coconut flavor.
